Haysyn Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytska oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This is the older of Haysyn's more recent Jewish cemeteries (alongside a separately documented newest and oldest cemetery), mostly demolished and overbuilt with a feed mill sometime between the 1960s and 1970, according to differing local and KSEN accounts. A small preserved section survives at the factory entrance, recently fenced, holding seven ohels — including that of Reuven Yosef of Haysyn, a disciple of the influential Hasidic master Rebbe Nachman of Breslov (Bratslav). Some of these ohels were rebuilt by Ohalei Tzaddikim, the same organization responsible for restoring Hasidic graves at Makariv and Prybuzhany, documented elsewhere in this collection.
